resolution.note: guard live-verified: php copy refused on public krn-works/krn before any push

title: Outside acceptance refuses non-public sources on a public remote
body:
Why: outside acceptance pushed operator repositories (a client production plugin, Tallystick, krn-search-lab) to the PUBLIC krn-works/krn; PR refs 868-878 still serve them (decision d-fe0823).
Outcome: scripts/outside-acceptance.ts pushes a scratch copy to a public remote only when the copy carries UPSTREAM.json naming a public upstream URL and an SPDX licence; any other copy exits non-zero before any git push.
Proof: node --test test/scripts/outside-acceptance.test.ts feeds a copy without a manifest and gets a refusal with no push.
